items.rationale: Clauses 2.3.3, 4.2.4 and 7.1.9 cover a like-for-like replacement of the damaged system, estimated at €285 gross. The €5,000 aggregate cap does not bind, and being plugged in does not establish that surge protection was absent, so no 50% reduction is applied.
Clause 7.1.8(b) excludes shipping for replacement equipment even when billed alongside covered equipment. The €5 estimate is conditional only; the expected allowance is zero.
Clause 7.1.8(c) excludes installing or connecting replacement equipment, even if billed as labour. The €8 estimate is conditional only; the expected allowance is zero.

Clauses 2.3.3 and 7.1.9 cover an equivalent pre-loss-specification TV at €565 gross, consistent with Case 9. The two replacements total €850, below the €5,000 aggregate cap; neither a missing protective device nor a scheduled deductible is established.

items.description: Combined electronics property and liability charge
items.rationale: Clauses 3.1.4 and 11.2 exclude the combined property and liability arrangement charge because no physical-damage element is separately itemised and priced. The €10 estimate is conditional only; the expected allowance is zero.
Clauses 3.1.4, 3.1.5 and 7.1.8(f) exclude charges for placing an order under the property and liability arrangement. The €6 estimate is conditional only; the expected allowance is zero.

Clause 7.1.8(d) permits an attendance charge only when indemnifiable work appears on the same invoice, and neither service line on this invoice qualifies. The €5 estimate is conditional only; the expected allowance is zero.
